home.announcement: Seasonal menus, thoughtful cooking and warm hospitality — discover Maison Élan.
home.hero_title: A Seasonal Table. A Lasting Impression.
home.hero_body: Discover considered plates shaped by the season, classic technique and a relaxed sense of occasion. From a leisurely lunch to an intimate evening, Maison Élan brings thoughtful food and warm hospitality to the table.
home.intro_title: A little more than a meal
home.intro_body: We believe the best dining experiences balance craft with ease. Our imagined kitchen brings together familiar European inspirations, carefully layered flavours and seasonal ingredients, served in a setting designed for conversation and connection.
home.seasonal_body: Our sample seasonal selection changes through the year, pairing comforting classics with lighter, produce-led plates. The dishes shown here are portfolio demo content; live availability would be controlled by the restaurant team.
home.experience_body: Mark a milestone, gather friends or plan a private dinner. Share a few details and our team will follow up with suitable options.

story.title: A modern house for good food
story.lead: Maison Élan is a fictional restaurant concept built around seasonal cooking, thoughtful detail and a welcoming approach to modern European dining.

sections.heading: Rooted in the season
sections.body: Our imagined menus follow the character of the season: bright herbs and tender vegetables in warmer months, roasted roots and deeper sauces when the weather turns. Seasonal specials are clearly marked and can be updated without rebuilding the website.

sections.heading: Classic technique, contemporary spirit
sections.body: From a carefully seared fish fillet to a slow-cooked ragù, the menu draws on European cooking traditions while keeping the presentation clean and the flavours balanced.

sections.heading: Hospitality without the fuss
sections.body: A special meal should feel considered, not complicated. The website is designed to make it easy to understand the menu, check availability, manage a booking and contact the team.

private_dining.title: Private Dining & Gatherings
private_dining.lead: For intimate celebrations, family occasions and small team dinners, tell us what you have in mind. Our demo team will review the enquiry and respond with suitable options.
private_dining.workflow: Enquiry only. Submitting this form records a request; it does not confirm a private event or reserve a room.

contact.title: We would love to hear from you
contact.body: For booking questions, menu enquiries or private dining requests, use the contact form. This portfolio demo uses placeholder contact details and does not represent a real trading restaurant.

journal_posts.title: Building a Seasonal Plate
journal_posts.excerpt: A good seasonal dish begins with a clear idea: one ingredient in focus, supporting flavours in balance and enough texture to make every bite interesting.

journal_posts.title: The Art of a Good Sauce
journal_posts.excerpt: A sauce should connect the elements of a plate. Acidity, texture and depth matter as much as richness, and a little restraint often makes the flavour clearer.

journal_posts.title: A Relaxed Guide to a Fine-Dining Visit
journal_posts.excerpt: There is no secret code to enjoying a considered meal. Ask questions, share dietary needs early and choose the dishes that genuinely appeal to you.

policies.reservation: Demo policy: reservations are confirmed only after the server has checked availability and returned a confirmed status. Please arrive near the reserved time and contact the restaurant if plans change. The live restaurant must replace this text with its actual policy.
policies.cancellation: Demo policy: customers may request cancellation through their account. Whether a booking is cancelled immediately or requires staff approval is determined by the implemented business rules. Replace this sample policy before production.
policies.ordering: Demo policy: menu prices and availability are rechecked by the server before an order is accepted. An order is not confirmed merely because the customer clicked the button; confirmation follows a successful backend response.
policies.allergens: Demo notice: ingredient and allergen records are illustrative software data and are not suitable for real food service. In a real restaurant, declarations must be checked against exact recipes, supplier specifications, kitchen processes and cross-contact controls. Guests with allergies should contact the restaurant directly.
policies.privacy: Demo privacy notice: this prototype may use seeded fictional accounts and test data. A production service must publish a reviewed privacy notice, define retention periods, secure personal data and provide a way to exercise applicable privacy rights.
